real-zen/1:
Un mattino d'autunno il famoso poeta Gessen si presentò al cospetto di Nan-in e gli chiese di indicargli il cammino più breve per raggiungere il Satori.
Nan-in indicò un gigantesco bastone e disse: "Se davvero desideri diventare saggio devi riuscire a vedere la natura-buddha di tutte le cose: prendi quell'oggetto con te e medita per tre anni, poi torna da me".
Quando Gessen fece ritorno, il maestro disse: "Non sei ancora pronto: medita per altri quattro anni, poi torna da me".
Quando il giovane allievo fece ritorno, Nan-in gli disse: "Seppuku, Mishima, Jambon!", e a quelle parole Gessen fu illuminato!
real-zen/42:
Un pomeriggio d'autunno Mamiya si recò presso Chao-chou e gli chiese di mostrargli il cammino più celere per raggiungere il Satori.
Chao-chou indicò una veste di gesso e disse: "Se veramente vuoi divenire illuminato devi riuscire a penetrare la buddha-natura di tutte le cose: prendi quell'oggetto con te e medita per quattro anni, poi torna da me".
Quando Mamiya tornò, il maestro disse: "Non sei ancora pronto: medita per altri dieci anni, poi torna da me".
Quando il giovane apprendista fece ritorno, Chao-chou gli disse: "Katana, Mishima, Jambon!", e a quelle parole Mamiya fu illuminato!
real-zen/99:

real-artex/1:
David Downsbrough
Wordgenesis
(2008)
Switzerland National Museum, Zurich, Switzerland

All art works are derived from a particular situation and consciousness, extracting observations and private histories from the artists' archive of personal experiences. Together these elements form within their layering an illusion of architectural dimensionality which never denies its inherent flatness, the installation reiterates the performative aspects of the making of the work. The success of Wordgenesis lies in this very process. Our idea of culture is severely restricted because we've always applied it to art; this art immerses viewers into the magic by which paint transforms itself into things being described and back again.

Ora guardate: se osservate bene, l'evento EnqueueField e' readonly. Perche', questo? Dipende: hanno gia' detto che alla prossima versione questo problema sara' eliminato. Personalmente, io avrei introdotto una classe chiamata System.Paint.Helder.Helder.Gastone. .TH POLYGEN 1 "September 15, 2004"
.SH NAME
Polygen - Polygen is an innovative gadget for bursting out cursory sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B polygen
.RI [options]
sources
.SH DESCRIPTION
Polygen is an advanced tool for generating automatic sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.PP
Formally, it is an interpreter of a language itself designed to define languages, where to interpret means executing a source program in real time and eventually outputting its result.
.PP
Here a source program is a grammar definition, the execution consists in the exploration of such grammar by selecting a random path and the result is the sentence built on the way.
.PP
Though PolyGen is quite a seriuos piece of software then, what else would be more noble for it than being used as a parody tool for linguistical habits, stereotypes and trends of this foolish era?
.PP
Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP
And randomization is perfect at this purpose thanks to its purely asemantic behaviour =:) 
.SH OPTIONS
Please run \fBpolygen\fP without parameters for an explanation on how to run \fBpolygen\fP.
.SH AUTHOR
Manta
.PP

.TH POLYGEN 1 "September 15, 2004"
.SH NAME
Polygen - Polygen is an innovative gadget for bursting out cursory sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B polygen
.RI [options]
sources
.SH DESCRIPTION
Polygen is an advanced tool for generating automatic sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.PP
Formally, it is an interpreter of a language itself designed to define languages, where to interpret means executing a source program in real time and eventually outputting its result.
.PP
Here a source program is a grammar definition, the execution consists in the exploration of such grammar by selecting a random path and the result is the sentence built on the way.
.PP
Though PolyGen is quite a seriuos piece of software then, what else would be more noble for it than being used as a parody tool for linguistical habits, stereotypes and trends of this foolish era?
.PP
Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP
And randomization is perfect at this purpose thanks to its purely asemantic behaviour =:) 
.SH OPTIONS
Please run \fBpolygen\fP without parameters for an explanation on how to run \fBpolygen\fP.
.SH AUTHOR
Manta
.PP

real-artex/7:
Twisting/Trying Before: Attilio Todosijevic, Sophie Varejao, Henrietta Lauridsen & Jonathan Vega

The art of Attilio Todosijevic emphasises an awareness of struggle for personal freedom, as readers, we fill in the gaps of her text and imagine far more than what we see, carrying our own interpretation of the lines. The title of the project captures the described image and concept. These objects are indeed more closely related to fables than to inventories, as much about what is implied as what is delineated; the installation reflects artist's idea of the animation of the machine as a mirror of identity. There is an archaeology of pollution and of people living and working with that.

.B polygen
.RI [options]
sources
.SH DESCRIPTION
Polygen is a system for computing causeless wisdom according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.PP
Formally, it is an interpreter of a language itself designed to define languages, where to interpret means executing a source program in real time and eventually outputting its result.

Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP

Smimanicara era un giovane sognatore che da 32 anni conduceva una vita stupida in mezzo a gente comune in un campo profughi. 
 Il suo sogno segreto era tuttavia quello di addomesticare qualche bidelloporco per studiare la magia o magari anche prevedere i terremoti. Invece non poteva far altro che andare in giro con i suoi mirabolanti amici Illefrumbyoppi e Smifalo, che erano due perfetti imbecilli e non pensavano mai di evocare il potere della terra. 
 Un giorno particolarmente mirabolante, Smimanicara fu mandato da sua zia al guado per comprare dei vestiti. Si sentiva di lontano il gracchiare dei tontodonti, ed era un mattino degno, cosi' il nostro Smimanicara decise di prendere una scorciatoia. Ben presto, pero', si accorse di essersi dissetato in una buca puzzolente e si spavento'. 
 Ma ecco che sogno' un baule che gli disse: 'Ricorda tuo cugino Noppaparedaria!' Allora Smimanicara si arrabbio' pochissimo poiche' la storia di Noppaparedaria gli era ben nota. 
 Noppaparedaria aveva litigato con un gruppo di nani e esplorando una casa diroccata era stato sfidato da una figura spigliata dotata di una voce musicale. Costui lo aveva pregato di rubare un Semicupio Canterino di Diamante per poter curare la sua grave dermatite. Mosso da fastidio, Noppaparedaria aveva quindi accettato di buon grado, visto anche che non sapeva giocare a carte.

.TH POLYGEN 1 "September 15, 2004"
.SH NAME
Polygen - Polygen is a tool for creating circumstantial sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B polygen
.RI [options]
sources
.SH DESCRIPTION
Polygen is a system for computing causeless wisdom according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.PP
Formally, it is an interpreter of a language itself designed to define languages, where to interpret means executing a source program in real time and eventually outputting its result.
.PP
Here a source program is a grammar definition, the execution consists in the exploration of such grammar by selecting a random path and the result is the sentence built on the way.
.PP
Though PolyGen is quite a seriuos piece of software then, what else would be more noble for it than being used as a parody tool for linguistical habits, stereotypes and trends of this foolish era?
.PP
Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP
And randomization is perfect at this purpose thanks to its purely asemantic behaviour =:) 
.SH OPTIONS
Please run \fBpolygen\fP without parameters for an explanation on how to run \fBpolygen\fP.
.SH AUTHOR
Manta
.PP

Pure' mistomare.

Vi presentiamo una portata fresca, perfetta per un pranzo estivo. Tempo di preparazione: sette ore e trenta minuti piu' una notte per la lievitazione. Ricetta per tre commensali: Iniziate a far lessare nove etti di caciottine; affettate sette tazze di spicchi di mela. Aggiungete al composto ottenuto nove chili di anatre. Nel frattempo avrete gia' marinato nel vino otto grammi di castagne: cio' e' da addizionare al sugo rimasto nel tegame. Fate riposare in frigorifero per due ore. Abbellite con porri e aggiungete dello zucchero. Servite in tavola caldo in una terrina di coccio. Il nostro sommelier caldeggia di innaffiare con un vino robusto, ottimo un brunello della valtellina, da servirsi freschissimo.
real-ricette/123:
Bomboloni paglia e fieno.

Si tratta una portata fresca, veloce e gustosa. Tempo di preparazione: cinque ore e quaranta minuti. Ricetta per tre persone: Iniziate a far saltare sette pinoli; miscelate due chili di uova di quaglia. Correggete con sette grammi di unita' di panna acida. Intanto avrete rosolato nove filetti di coniglio: cio' e' da miscelare al vostro preparato. Saltate nel lardo. Abbellite con mais e passate nel passaverdure. Servite rovente in un plateau. Si consiglia di accompagnare con un nettare importante, ottimo un primitivo di salaparuta, da servire decisamente ghiacciato.
real-ricette/31337:
Maccheroni  millearomi.

Vi presentiamo oggi una ricetta antichissima, di cui anche Marco Polo raccontava nel suo Milione. Tempo di preparazione: due ore e cinquanta minuti. E' un piatto difficilissimo. Ricetta per quattro persone: Lasciate sobbollire tre etti di foglie di catalogna; sminuzzate quattro cucchiaini di fettine di mango. Addolcite con quattro prese di pepe. Nel frattempo avrete gia' messo a bagno per trentasei ore due scorze di limone: questo e' da unire al sugo rimasto nella padella. Fate riposare in frigorifero per otto secondi. Guarnite con cetrioli e regolate di sale. Servite in tavola ghiacciato in un piatto da pesce. Si consiglia di degustare con un vino robusto, tra cui suggeriamo un pinot nero vinificato bianco di montepulciano, da offrire previa decantazione.

Lisbon Metropolitan Gallery, Lisbon, Portugal

The new works reflect the artist's ambition to capture his own experiences and observations in such a poetic and abstract manner; the artist fills seemingly simple images with light and air to evoke a sense of purity and serenity, it is up to the viewer to decide whether to immerse in the sub-text, whether or not to participate in the scenario; it's like an enchantment, in Africa Time, Iain Long entwines language and architecture in a complex work touching every aspect of community.

Henrik Semmes, Allan Sonnier
Trying Or Creating

Lipski Museum of art, Vienna, Austria

Henrik Semmes's nearly imperceptible sound paths unconsciously stop the visitors in their tracks; that is the transformations and the invented narratives through thousands of repetitive images; within each work a 'statement' functions to describe the continuum within a balance of constants and variables. Henrik Semmes's objects are condoms, nails and candybars, that is the transformations and the invented narratives through thousands of repetitive images, our idea of culture is severely restricted because we've always applied it to art.

[The Word] by Olafur Adeagbo, Giulio Lucas, Ricardo Boursier mougenot & Sun Pistoletto

1960

The work does result from an awareness of the kinds of activity: collecting, analysing and sharing data, these works reflect a dramatic change from Olafur Adeagbo's biting social commentaries on struggle for personal freedom to works expressing the inner being in relationship to the beauty of creation on earth and beyond, we are faced with what appears to be a direct transcription of the impossible.

[Opening Over]
Charles Cock

Charles Cock's nearly imperceptible sound paths unconsciously stop the visitors in their tracks; it's like an enchantment; these objects are indeed more closely related to fables than to inventories, as much about what is implied as what is delineated. This consciousness prompts the artists to deal with the political, the geographical, and the everyday in a non-didactic way, leading to new ways of exploring and understanding individual circumstances. Charles Cock's work confronts the spectator, while distancing him/her from their intense experience. We are forced to explore the question of how the museum consciously or unconsciously perpetuates beliefs and behavior; the success of Opening Over lies in this very process, in Opening Over, Charles Cock entwines language and architecture in a complex work touching every aspect of identity.

Senza dubbio in una Weltanschaaung di smarrimento derivata da sonorita' mute probabilmente oniriche, e probabilmente sequenziali, il soggetto potrebbe considerarsi differentemente, facendo menzione del senso dei pericoli e dell'inutilita' del sistema paragonato alle casualsonorita' mute di Mijatowskij.

Probabilmente in un contesto di pulsione improntato a disposizioni luminose forse barocche, il protagonista potrebbe considerarsi probabilmente preterdifferentemente.

.TH POLYGEN 1 "September 15, 2004"
.SH NAME
Polygen - Polygen is a system for computing accidental nonsense according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B polygen
.RI [options]
sources
.SH DESCRIPTION
Polygen is a program for computing enlightening sentences according to a grammar definition, that is following custom syntactical and lexical rules. 
.PP
Formally, it is an interpreter of a language itself designed to define languages, where to interpret means executing a source program in real time and eventually outputting its result.
.PP
Here a source program is a grammar definition, the execution consists in the exploration of such grammar by selecting a random path and the result is the sentence built on the way.
.PP
Though PolyGen is quite a seriuos piece of software then, what else would be more noble for it than being used as a parody tool for linguistical habits, stereotypes and trends of this foolish era?
.PP
Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP
And randomization is perfect at this purpose thanks to its purely asemantic behaviour =:) 
.SH OPTIONS
Please run \fBpolygen\fP without parameters for an explanation on how to run \fBpolygen\fP.
.SH AUTHOR
Manta
.PP

Principles of parody are focusing a ridiculous topic and eventually abstracting its rules and schemes (here in terms of a grammar definition) by which reproducing it through the variatio device.
.PP
And randomization is perfect at this purpose thanks to its purely asemantic behaviour =:)
